title: Boys' Fashion Mix in the Governed Catalog
summary: Boys' fashion in this catalog is casual-led children's apparel: T-shirts dominate (about 64% of 830 Boys products), followed by shirts, shorts, and jeans. Colours skew blue, white, red, yellow, and black; usage is 96% casual; and Summer is the dominant season. Coverage is assortment-based and concentrated in 2011-2012.

widgets.description: Count of Boys products by article type, showing T-shirts lead by a wide margin.
widgets.accessibilityText: Horizontal bar chart listing Boys product counts by article type. T-shirts are the largest group at 531 of 830 products, followed by shirts at 78, shorts at 55, jeans at 30, and casual shoes at 24.
